title: A Restriction Theorem for Springer Fibers
attribution: GPT-6 Astra; communicated and edited by Boming Jia
abstract: Let $G$ be a connected complex reductive group, $\mathcal{B}$ its flag variety, and $\mathcal{B}_{e}$ the Springer fiber of a nilpotent element $e\in\mathrm{Lie}\,G$. Let $S$ be the torus associated with an $\mathfrak{sl}_{2}$-triple containing $e$. We prove that the image of the restriction map on complex cohomology $H^{*}(\mathcal{B}^{S})\to H^{*}(\mathcal{B}_{e}^{S})$ between the $S$-fixed point loci is the subalgebra of invariants under the component group $A(e)$ of the centralizer of $e$ in $G$. This proves a conjecture of Hoang, Krylov, and Matvieievskyi. The argument uses global invariant cycles. As an application, we give another proof of the known surjectivity for general linear groups.

This proves a conjecture of Hoang, Krylov, and Matvieievskyi. The argument uses global invariant cycles. As an application, we give another proof of the known surjectivity for general linear groups.

title: On the Minimal Orbital Scheme $\overline{\mathcal O}_{\min}\cap\mathfrak n^{+}$
attribution: GPT-6 Astra; communicated and edited by Boming Jia
abstract: Let $\mathfrak g$ be a complex simple Lie algebra, let $\mathfrak n^{+}$ be the nilradical of a Borel subalgebra, and let $\mathcal O_{\min}$ be the minimal nonzero nilpotent orbit. We prove that $\overline{\mathcal O}_{\min}\cap\mathfrak n^{+}$ is generically reduced in every type. In simply laced type, it is reduced and Cohen–Macaulay. In non-simply laced type, it is nonreduced and, being generically reduced, fails Serre's condition $(S_1)$. In simply laced type, a quadratic Gröbner basis degenerates its coordinate ring to the Stanley–Reisner ring of the positive-root order complex. As a consequence, minimal scheme-theoretic Springer fibers are generically reduced in every type, reduced and Cohen–Macaulay in simply laced type, and nonreduced in non-simply laced type.

title: The Minimal Leaf of $T^*(G/U)^{\mathrm{aff}}$
attribution: GPT-6 Astra; communicated and edited by Boming Jia
abstract: Let $G$ be a simply connected simple complex algebraic group, and let $U$ be a maximal unipotent subgroup. Assume that $G$ is not of type $A_1$ or $A_2$. We construct a $G$-equivariant closed Poisson embedding of the minimal nilpotent orbit closure into $T^*(G/U)^{\mathrm{aff}}$. The image of the minimal orbit is a symplectic leaf contained in the closure of every positive-dimensional symplectic leaf. It is the unique positive-dimensional leaf of smallest dimension.
